concrete_defects.actual: Code uses unqualified Path/Path.of repeatedly but supplies no java.nio.file.Path import; static typing issue, not observed javac RED.

First earlyWALL asserts dirtySinceSave=false while the real candidate early frontier requires dirty and explicitly preserves that annual tail/savedpair. Fresh after-SEM SAFE does not grant saved credit or clear dirty.
Early clean WALL maps in Controller finally to BATCH_DEFERRED, not the asserted BATCH_FINISHED. The draft treats a scheduler deferral as a normal finished report.

It first runs controller.runBatch standalone then invokes a new RootLoop; that loop starts new batches instead of consuming the already produced report. It does not prove the claimed first report-to-nextbatch coupling.

Main test Control.stopRequested returns false forever and onBatchCompleted only appends reports. No demonstrated finite callback cut supports reports.size==2/result.sequence==2; a small-action producer may continue issuing more actions.
STOP test Control.stopRequested is true from the beginning. Actual RootLoop tests it before any batch, so zero reports, not the asserted one.

The effect originalEvidence and execution.guard.nativeEvidence are both the same REF, contradicting included ActionEffects.validateComposite requirement that the terminal semantic original differ from guard native evidence. Merely tagging Life handler and Applied cannot establish a legal complete Life DTO.

Default/annual/turnbound examples use five-second wall while the same first-action implementation advances601seconds and initial dirty/default setup is not qualified. Their precise expected terminals are not justified; no execution is claimed.
